nom: St. Ives Acne Control Apricot Face Scrub

avis.texte: I love this apricot scrub but definitely don’t use every day, most especially not twice a day. It can be too rough on acne prone/sensitive skin so only use 3 times a week, 4 max. I prefer doing it Monday, Wednesday or Thursday, and Saturday, only in the mornings because it does make my skin really soft and bright when I use it only a few days a week. Definitely worth the price and the rating. I’m rating 5 stars overall though because using it twice a day, everyday was my own fault, and once I settled into a routine of it a few times a week, it worked perfectly. Got a set of 4 bottles for about $18, and I love them

avis.titre: Gentle dirt and oil exfoliant that also does not dry out your skin
avis.texte: Same scrub that kept Price Rogers Nelson looking so good (appears on his beauty stand in his post death house pictures...who knew?), and a staple in my beauty routine as well for well over a decade and my skin looks great with folks regularly thinking me younger than I am! The crushed almond shells impart just enough abrasion to get the job done without being harsh to sensitive skin. #Winner
Nice set, perfect to use as a facial scrub. Works well and I like getting this product in bulk for a reasonable price.

Love this Face/Body scrub! I use it on my face, arms, shoulders and upper back. It is a great cleanser and, if regularly used, helps take care of/keep acne away. It also doesn’t hurt that it smells really good. :-D Long time user of this product.

avis.titre: Removes dead skin leaves your face glowing
avis.texte: Polishes your skin and removes dead skin cells. Do you have a glowing complexion it removes any dry patches of skin and even out skin tone. It is not packed full of chemicals. It has natural ingredients in the grit in it is made to scrub off your dead skin. A must for every bathroom it’s like polishing your face.
Love this product. It works great when used as directed. Exfoliates well. Smells great too. Leaves my skin feeling soft.
Love this. Have bought it many times over the years. It makes my face feel smooth and soft and gives it a refreshing feeling
Ce produit est vraiment bien je l’utilise depuis un moment déjà et vraiment conquise il élimine les points noirs!!
Excelente compra y justo lo que buscaba. El producto tiene extractos de la semilla, por lo que ayuda a una exfoliación profunda. Llegó justo en el tiempo estimado.
Meilleur gommage pour une personne avec une peau à problème comme moi

I love St. Ives Acne Control Scrub! I started using it many years ago because a friend said if you use it daily you can prevent crow's feet wrinkles. Here I am, 30 years later and I still don't have crow's feet! Maybe I'm just blessed with good skin, but I don't think so. I think it's the scrub. I use it on my whole face and neck when I shower. I'm always careful to rub it in well at the corners of my eyes where crow's feet develop and over my lips. It leaves my skin exfoliated and feeling fresh and clean. I've been using it for so long now I probably should have bought stock in the company!
I love St Ives! It is the best facial scrub ever, this is such a great deal!
Honestly, i do see it’s doing something but I’m still breaking out so I would say acne control... still great I guess. This is after using it for a week and a half.

Hey guys! I’m reviewing the St. Ives Acne control Abricot scrub! - Damn, that’s a mouth full. - I’ve been using this once a week, for about 3 weeks, and i can say i’ve seen some improvement. - I use this once a week, because i have sensitive skin... - it has a sweet,yet subtle smell, and feels cooling on the skin. It does make my skin feel a little tight after but it did not burn, nor tingle. - my skin has cleared up a little, primarily getting rid of redness. - but my favorite thing about it, is that it smoothed my skin, getting rid of most of the bumps, while simultaneously getting rid of dead skin cells. - It’s an oil-free salicylic acid acne medication (Anti-inflammatory used to treat acne, psoriasis, or warts!) It’s also Paraben free, (which can clogs pores) and dermatologist tested. it contains 2.0% salicylic acid, btw. It’s inactive ingredients include : Water (Aqua), Juglans Regia (Walnut) Shell Powder, Glycol Stearate SE, Glycerin, Sodium Lauryl Sulfoacetate, Zea Mays (Corn) Kernel Meal, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, Cetearyl Alcohol, Triethanolamine, Cetyl Alcohol, Glyceryl Stearate, PEG-100 Stearate, Prunus Armeniaca (Apricot) Fruit Extract, Cetyl Acetate, Ceteareth-20, Carbomer, Polysorbate 60, Acetylated Lanolin Alcohol, Fragrance (Parfum), PPG-2 Methyl Ether, Phenethyl Alcohol, Methylisothiazolinone, Titanium Dioxide (CI 77891). - It’s most definitely going to stay in my rotation!
